newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end up, but off early highs - APR 09.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end up, but off early highs - APR 09.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended up on Wednesday, but were off early highs as speculators booked profits in select blue chips towards the close of the new accounts day, dealers said.

"Trading was extremly dull today as investors continued to remain on the sidelines because of the country's grim economic outlook," dealer Ali Asghar said. "Speculative interest was limited to a handful of active scrips which slipped later on booking of profits."
The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) index rose 7.27 points, or 0.46 percent, to end at 1,573.08 after reaching 1,578.57.
Losers led gainers 199 to 96. Turnover fell to 30.86 million shares from 41.52 million on Tuesday.
Hub Power fell 0.20 to 37.40 rupees, ICI Pakistan 0.30 to 24.25, PTCL 0.45 to 29.10 and Dewan Salman Fibre 0.20 to 38.45.
